proposed_comments.title: Delete incomplete staging files even when stream disposal fails
Release the sequential-transfer worker when startup times out
proposed_comments.body:
### Release the sequential-transfer worker when startup times out

**Severity:** `low`

If this startup assertion times out on a loaded test host, execution never enters the `finally`, so `firstReceive` remains blocked and the event can be disposed underneath it. Move the wait inside the protected region so every failure path releases and awaits the worker.

```suggestion
        try
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(firstTransferCompleted.Wait(millisecondsTimeout: 1000));

```

proposed_comments.title: Release the overlapping-transfer worker when startup times out
proposed_comments.body:
### Release the overlapping-transfer worker when startup times out

**Severity:** `low`

This assertion has the same lifetime problem: a timeout occurs before the `finally`, leaving the first worker blocked while it holds the static clipboard receive gate. Put the startup wait inside the `try` so cleanup always signals and awaits that worker, preventing cascading failures in later tests.

```suggestion
        try
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(firstReceiveStarted.Wait(millisecondsTimeout: 1000));

```
